title: Dolphin Cove Marina-Boat Rentals & Tours
specs: Island beach stops and shelling opportunities
Scenic cruises including Gulf sunsets and luxury home views
All non-residents 16 and over and any resident from 16 to 64 are required to have a Florida boating license
Well behaved dogs allowed, must keep off seats or use towel
includes: Bottled Water and Cooler with Ice
gap: Exact boat rental prices and durations not stated
blurb: Guests can rent boats or book private boat tours including dolphin watching, sunset cruises, island stops, and wildlife viewing. Tours range from 2 to 5 hours and accommodate up to 6 guests. The marina provides safety equipment, bottled water, and coolers with ice on tours.
extraNote: Trip protection available for $35 allowing cancellation up to 8:30 a.m. on departure day for full refund less trip protection fee · Damage waiver $35 covers first $1,000 in damages; renter responsible for damage over $1,000 · Ungrounding coverage $35; ungrounding fees range from $500 to $1500 depending on location and hours
